caveats.message: Land cover is the ESA WorldCover 2021 epoch with no time series, so the 2013 and 2016 events are both modelled against 2021 conditions. Aqaba developed across that decade, in the direction that increases runoff.
Soil properties come from SoilGrids, a global model, not from local sampling. Use them as a relative erodibility ranking between catchments; no value here is a measured local soil property.
Component A predicts runoff OCCURRENCE, not volume. No m3 figure exists; this is a gap, not a zero.
